assets.notes: Vara's native harpy-eagle rig supersedes the Storm Hornbill pre-vis. Eleven in-place avian clips at 30 fps include the dedicated downward head-sweep Sky Survey; source geometry, skin, provider task and production evidence gates remain unchanged.
assets.evidence: Native harpy-eagle rig (50 joints, 23,716 tris), eleven native in-place clips at 30 fps. Sky Survey has measured centroid displacement 0.0132 m in its authoring report. Existing deformation and locked-hardware production gates remain unverified.
